summary: A Depth subscription: the 166-byte snapquote gives the best five each side and the day's figures; it has no LTP, so both sides publish its average trade price as ltp; an empty book is five zero levels each side on both.

notes: Average as LTP is inherited from the web (audit inherited limitation 1): both publish 1498.76 here, pinned as it is.
A Depth subscriber gets the book frame only; the desktop's frame takes its quote fields from the snapquote's own tick.

deviations.reason: The desktop puts its mode label (ltp, quote, full) in data.mode; the Pocketful web adapter's frames carry its own. Follows each broker's own web adapter (lead rule 2026-11-09): set by the per-broker dialect switch in Phase B.

The snapquote packet carries no trade time; the web leaves ltt out of its Depth frame, the desktop sends the time it received the packet as ltt. A Depth frame must leave out what the stream does not carry (CLAUDE.md, web openalgo#2376): mark it absent in the Pocketful adapter.

The snapquote packet carries no last traded quantity; the web leaves last_quantity out of its Depth frame, the desktop sends last_quantity 0. A Depth frame must leave out what the stream does not carry (CLAUDE.md, web openalgo#2376): mark it absent in the Pocketful adapter.

The snapquote packet carries no last traded quantity; the web leaves last_trade_quantity out of its Depth frame, the desktop sends its alias last_trade_quantity 0. A Depth frame must leave out what the stream does not carry (CLAUDE.md, web openalgo#2376): mark it absent in the Pocketful adapter.

The snapquote packet's only price is the average trade price, which both sides publish as ltp; the web leaves average_price out, the desktop sends average_price 0.0, a wrong number. Send the average as average_price (or leave it out); never 0.

The snapquote packet carries no open interest; the web leaves oi out of its Depth frame, the desktop sends oi 0. A Depth frame must leave out what the stream does not carry (CLAUDE.md, web openalgo#2376): mark it absent in the Pocketful adapter.

The snapquote packet carries no open interest; the web leaves open_interest out of its Depth frame, the desktop sends open_interest 0. A Depth frame must leave out what the stream does not carry (CLAUDE.md, web openalgo#2376): mark it absent in the Pocketful adapter.
